issues.legal_issue: Income from trust property is exempt when a beneficiary validly relinquishes all beneficial rights and the property is thereafter held solely for charitable purposes.
material_facts: A trust deed provided for income to be paid to a beneficiary during her lifetime and for the income to be used for specified public charitable purposes thereafter.
The beneficiary executed a valid surrender of her income interest and other rights under the trust, intending the interest to vest in the trustees for the specified charitable purposes.
The income at issue accrued after the surrender, when the charitable purpose was the only purpose of the trust that remained.
issues.conclusion: The income accruing after the surrender was exempt from income tax under section 4(3)(i) of the Income-tax Act, 1922.
issues.legal_principle: Under section 4(3)(i) of the Income-tax Act, 1922, income from property held wholly for charitable or religious purposes is exempt to the extent it is applied or accumulated for application to those purposes. A beneficiary competent to contract may transfer their interest under section 58 of the Indian Trusts Act, 1882. Under section 41(1) of the Income-tax Act, 1922, trust income is treated for tax purposes as received by trustees on behalf of beneficiaries and taxed in their hands as it would be in the hands of the beneficiary; this does not make the income the beneficiary’s own income. No earlier cases were relied on.

rule.if: income_tax_exemption_dispute and valid_charitable_trust and beneficiary_validly_relinquished_interest and remaining_trust_purpose_is_charitable

predicates.income_tax_exemption_dispute: The proceeding concerns whether income from property held on trust is exempt from income tax.
predicates.valid_charitable_trust: The property is held under a valid trust that includes a charitable purpose.
predicates.beneficiary_validly_relinquished_interes: A beneficiary competent to do so validly gave up all rights to the trust interest that had been for that beneficiary’s benefit.
predicates.remaining_trust_purpose_is_charitable: After the beneficiary gave up those rights, the only purpose remaining for the trustees to carry out was charitable.

issues.definition: When a tax-exemption dispute concerns a valid trust and a beneficiary has validly relinquished their interest so that only a charitable purpose remains, the income accruing thereafter is exempt.

issues.legal_issue: Trust income reserved for charitable application is exempt even if the trust terms prevent its immediate application and it must instead accumulate for later charitable use.
material_facts: The trust deed directed that income be applied to specified charitable purposes from and after the beneficiary’s death.
The beneficiary surrendered her beneficial rights, so the trustees no longer had to pay income to her.

The court did not decide whether the deed permitted immediate charitable application while the beneficiary remained alive; it held that, even if it did not, the income would accumulate for later application to the specified charitable purposes.
issues.conclusion: Any income that accumulated after the surrender for later application to the specified charitable purposes was exempt from income tax.
issues.legal_principle: Section 4(3)(i) of the Income-tax Act, 1922, exempts income from property held wholly for charitable or religious purposes where the income is either applied to those purposes or accumulated for application to them. The court treated the accumulation-for-charity basis as sufficient even if immediate application was not permitted. No earlier cases were relied on.

rule.if: income_tax_exemption_dispute and beneficiary_rights_have_ended and immediate_charitable_application_is_unavailable and trust_income_accumulates_for_charity

predicates.income_tax_exemption_dispute: The proceeding concerns whether income from property held on trust is exempt from income tax.
predicates.beneficiary_rights_have_ended: The beneficiary’s rights to receive or use trust property have ceased.
predicates.immediate_charitable_application_is_unav: The trust terms or circumstances prevent the trustees from applying the income to charity immediately.
predicates.trust_income_accumulates_for_charity: The trustees retain the income for later application to charitable purposes.

issues.definition: If a beneficiary’s rights have ended and trust income that cannot be applied immediately is accumulated for later charitable use, the accumulated income is exempt.
